title: Peddi
plot_overview: In a village that officially goes unrecognized, a laborer draws on his exceptional athletic ability to fight for his community’s right to be acknowledged. His struggle brings together physical determination and a larger demand for dignity, recognition, and justice.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like socially charged action dramas such as Pushpa: The Rise - Part 1; Not for you if mismatched lip-sync or uneven dialogue delivery quickly distracts you.
review_summary: Pros: compelling social premise; athletic central conflict; strong performances | Cons: uneven lip-sync; dialogue delivery issues
